positions.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
* Management of multi-origin, zero-downtime, highly scalable web infrastructure.
* Design, development, and improvement of automation and tooling for systems management. 
* Architecture design and implementation for complex systems spanning multiple globally distributed origins with zero downtime. 
* Extensive management of AWS infrastructure, developing custom tooling and automation as needed.
* Extensive development of automation via custom Opscode Chef cookbooks.
* Frequent collaboration, guidance, and support of multiple application and operational teams.

Notable projects:
* Fully automated implementation of multi-site, redundant, clustered Splunk environment. (Both indexing and search tiers) 
* Significant reduction in operating costs of Splunk environment via architectural optimization, without sacrificing capacity or performance.
* Design and implementation of multi-cluster, federated RabbitMQ architecture.
* Design and implementation of multiple Solr Cloud clusters, capable of autoscaling and automated management.
* Statsd implementation capable of handling 100k UDP messages/second with zero loss.

Tools and Technologies:  AWS (EC2, VPC, S3, Lambda, Route53, IAM, KMS, ESS, ACM, Cloudwatch, CloudFormation), Chef, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, RHEL (6 & 7), Apache, Tomcat, NodeJS, RabbitMQ, Solr, Splunk, Sensu, Statsd, Collectd, Graphite, ELK, Ruby, Python, Java

positions.title: Splunk Administrator at Best Buy
positions.description:
* Optimization of Splunk infrastructure
* Deployments of new releases
* Data Onboarding for new application tiers and data sources
* Partnering with users to help them more efficiently and effectively leverage Splunk
* Creation and maintenance of custom Splunk applications, dashboards, and knowledge objects
